<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Soulgazers </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107315521257572.png?v=1" alt="soulgazer" title="soulgazer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be killed in the Wilderness, the stalker dungeon in Zamorak's hideout, and the Sunken Pyramid. The Sunken Pyramid is easier to loot in and has no cannonball cost, but the Wilderness spawns can drop </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006481325076787240.png?v=1" alt="revenantdropenhancer" title="revenantdropenhancer" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level: 99</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill: 1950.4</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~420 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ~490kph </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour: ~819k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ~956k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

Using Seeker's Charms </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1027212537411932160.png?v=1" alt="seekerscharm" title="seekerscharm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is highly recommended to increase the rate of elites from 1/50 to 1/10</nowiki></p>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><ins><nowiki>Location and How to Get there</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Wilderness (level 27 Wilderness)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place and load the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in the open area a few tiles east of the lava pool</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Northeast of the level 18 obelisk, accessible via </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137735861937655900.png?v=1" alt="portableobelisk" title="portableobelisk" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/qGhOmREHX2.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Sunken Pyramid (south-eastern room, 5 spawns)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In the small room, position yourself six tiles south of the northern statue (northeastern corner of the brazier's shadow)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can teleport there with a teleport to house tablet, or with a Slayer Codex </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097517249499254875.png?v=1" alt="slayercodex" title="slayercodex" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-necromancy"><ins><nowiki>Method: Necromancy</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Soulgazers can be effectively AFK'd in the Sunken Pyramid and the Wilderness using Necromancy due to its high damage output and sustain from </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434409913634816.png?v=1" alt="commandghost" title="commandghost" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1" alt="vampyrismaspect" title="vampyrismaspect" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="sunken-pyramid"><nowiki>Sunken Pyramid</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Elite soulgazers should be focused when they spawn as they have KO potential when ignored</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="deflectmage" title="deflectmage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1" alt="ruination" title="ruination" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1" alt="ancientshard" title="ancientshard" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1" alt="elderovl" title="elderovl" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1" alt="aggressionpotion" title="aggressionpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are active at all times, drinking a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1" alt="superprayerrenewal" title="superprayerrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> dose whenever you drink a weapon poison</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure that </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1" alt="vampyrismaspect" title="vampyrismaspect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is active at all times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Set the autofire rate of your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773044296216666.png?v=1" alt="bloodreaver" title="bloodreaver" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to 15</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="wilderness"><nowiki>Wilderness</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Elite soulgazers should be focused when they spawn as they have KO potential when ignored</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="deflectmage" title="deflectmage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1" alt="sorrow" title="sorrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1" alt="ruination" title="ruination" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1" alt="ancientshard" title="ancientshard" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1" alt="elderovl" title="elderovl" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are active at all times, drinking a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1" alt="superprayerrenewal" title="superprayerrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> dose whenever you drink a weapon poison</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Soulgazer's in the Wilderness are permanently aggressive, so </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1" alt="aggressionpotion" title="aggressionpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> required</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure that </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069423047442573.png?v=1" alt="vampyrismaspect" title="vampyrismaspect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is active at all times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Set the autofire rate of your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773044296216666.png?v=1" alt="bloodreaver" title="bloodreaver" kind="icon" /><nowiki> based on how much damage you're taking and calibrate accordingly</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics_1"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=pODx8KbWN6mGZu9eWCiW <nowiki>Magic - Sunken Pyramid</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
